verdict.rationale: Vue's docs tout a 'truly reactive' system (vue-docs-4) and the Composition API's explicit ref/reactive primitives are meant to make data flow traceable, but hands-on community reports directly contradict this: developers report confusion tracing state because values are passed by reference and mutated 'anywhere downward the tree' (vue-comm-2), and another engineer describes 'a lot of implicit state changes wrecking havoc' from two-way binding in real large apps (vue-comm-11). missing for 10: first-party documentation explicitly addressing debugging/tracing state changes, and evidence resolving the community-reported confusion around implicit reactivity.
